name: Skoll
source:
A British executive assistant working in biotech.

A refined and well-mannered gentleman, Skoll exudes an air of elegance and calm, with a distant coolness beneath his friendly demeanor.

Devoted to his career, he considers his work the entirety of his life, showing litte interest in other aspects. Skoll regards himself as a boring person but sees no reason to change.
